posts.title: Hierarchical Conformal Classification
posts.description: Our paper on providing reliable neuro-symbolic classification by combining search and learning based on conformal prediction has been accepted at NeurIPS 2026 . I will be presented the poster in the Paris edition of NeurIPS 2026. You can find the accompanying webpage here . posts.title: SHARPIE at the European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning 2026
posts.description: Together with Shihan Wang from Utrecht University, I will present SHARPIE at the European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning in Lille. We will be presenting this paper as a poster. This is a systems paper presenting a system for controlled experiments involving human users and sequential decision-making agents that are common in e.g. reinforcement learning.
